scope: Conceptual review only, no code/model/CPU admission or experiment authorization

required_gaps: Specify which non-invertible operation releases capacity and its approximation cost; reversible refactorization alone does not.

Define computable bounded historical functional statistics; local covariance does not guarantee old-answer preservation under upstream drift.
Close the full final-weight budget including all shared factors, layer coefficients, residuals and remaining model, with training history and temporary cost separate.
conditional_minimum_controls: If both consolidation and functional constraints remain claimed mechanisms: matched-initialization matched-final-budget 2x2, with extra work charged. A same-size independent-factor reference is additionally needed only when claiming sharing itself helps.
